summary.name: Dynamic Dark Mode
summary.one_liner: A macOS menu bar app that automatically toggles system Dark Mode based on sunset, dim light, or a custom schedule.
keywords: toggle dark mode from menu bar
auto switch dark light theme mac
use_cases: Automatically switch macOS to dark mode after sunset
Reduce eye strain at night on a Mac
Toggle dark mode from the menu bar without System Preferences
Schedule dark mode on a custom time
Install a macOS dark mode utility via Homebrew
summary.what_it_does: Dynamic Dark Mode is a menu bar app for macOS Mojave and later that switches the system Dark Mode on and off. It can enable dark mode in dim lighting, after sunset, or at any time the user chooses, and it switches back to light mode in the morning. The page says it can be installed with Homebrew Cask or downloaded directly from a release page. A comparison table lists features such as daylight schedule, custom schedule, ambient light, Touch Bar, shortcut key, CLI, and per-app support, with Dynamic Dark Mode checked for several of them. The project is licensed under GPL v3.
notable: Installable via Homebrew Cask (brew install --cask dynamic-dark-mode)
Ambient light based switching uses screen brightness and needs 'Automatically adjust brightness' enabled
Licensed under GNU GPL v3, copyright Zhiyu Zhu (ApolloZhu)
Comparison table of alternatives such as NightOwl, f.lux, Shifty and darkmode by katernet
caveats: Ambient light switching depends on the 'Automatically adjust brightness' setting being enabled
